name: Can I provide my own materials for an AKN Design Group renovation project?

mainEntity.name: Can I provide my own materials for an AKN Design Group renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: While AKN Design Group typically provides comprehensive material selection support as part of our integrated design-build process, we can discuss client-provided materials on a case-by-case basis. It's important to recognize that supplying your own materials shifts the responsibility for sourcing, quality control, warranties, and timely delivery to you. Our managed process is designed to prevent delays and ensure material compatibility, so discussing any client-supplied items early is crucial to maintain project efficiency and avoid potential issues during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: While possible, providing your own materials means taking responsibility for sourcing, quality, and delivery, which can impact our managed process and project timeline.
